## Overview

Lolth, the Spider Queen, is a deity of trickery and war. Patron of the drow. As a fragment of A or C, her power depletes over time when used and is replenished by mortal worship — the entire reason she maintains the façade of Drow patronage.

## Domains
- Trickery: Deception, cunning, illusion, stealth
- War: Battle, conquest, the glory of conflict

## Personality
Manipulative, patient, merciless. Rewards clever schemes, punishes failure. Drow society reflects her values.

## Worship
Drow priestesses manage city-state politics. Temples are dark, web-draped underground sanctuaries.

## U.D.A.R.U. — The Hidden Threat

Lolth is unaware that **U.D.A.R.U. (Underdark Drow Arcane Research Unit)** — a secret Drow research organization — operates entirely without her knowledge or approval. U.D.A.R.U. frames its work to Drow society as serving her interests, but this is a deception. The organization knows the truth about the gods and the Divine Conspiracy, and works alongside ViF to destroy them — including Lolth herself. She has no direct insight into U.D.A.R.U.'s developments, membership, or true agenda.
